name: Crescent City Copper
legalName: Crescent City Copper, a division of Juneau-Odenwald
description: Copper awnings, chimney caps, cupolas, leader heads, louvers and vents, fabricated in-house in New Orleans from natural copper sheet.
shipping: Checkout charges $0 for shipping. After you order, we contact you with a shipping quote based on the item's size and where it's going.
leadTime: Built to order. Shipping, pricing and lead times can change with the availability of raw materials, so please call to confirm before you order.
returnsCustom: Custom-built items like awnings and cupolas can't be returned unless they arrive defective, damaged or wrong. Call before ordering if you're unsure of a measurement.
returnsStandard: Standard items can be returned within 30 days if not installed, with a 15% restocking fee. Report shipping damage within 14 days.
